mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id, l.lms_user_id, u.user_name, c.course_id, c.course_name, ca.company_attendance_id, sa.student_attendance_id, s.date AS training_date, sa.training_start_time, sa.training_end_time, sa.blank_time, sa.status, sa.note FROM m_place p INNER JOIN t_user_place up ON p.place_id = up.place_id AND up.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_lms_user l ON up.lms_user_id = l.lms_user_id AND l.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_user u ON l.user_id = u.user_id AND u.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN t_course_user cu ON l.lms_user_id = cu.lms_user_id AND cu.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_course c ON cu.course_id = c.course_id AND c.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_section s ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND s.date >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND s.date < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY/MM/DD') + INTERVAL '1 day' AND s.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_student_attendance sa ON l.lms_user_id = sa.lms_user_id AND s.date = sa.training_date AND sa.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_company_attendance ca ON l.lms_user_id = ca.lms_user_id AND s.date = ca.training_date AND ca.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} WHERE ( ca.training_date IS NULL OR (ca.training_date IS NOT NULL AND ca.training_start_time = '' AND ca.training_end_time = '' AND ca.status <> '1') ) AND u.authority = '0001' AND p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} ORDER BY s.date ASC, l.lms_user_id ASC
